creativeNote: The refreshed ads went live around 19–20 October. findings.title: New creative is generating leads
findings.body: Through 29 October, the Refunding Users repost recorded 5 leads and 2 Meta-reported registrations on NZ$537.22; the IRD Letter static recorded 5 leads and no reported registrations on NZ$190.81. These are cumulative figures. The difference in reported registrations needs checking against Lodg's records before drawing conclusions about lead quality.

findings.title: Leads rose, reported registrations fell
findings.body: Compared with 16–22 October, 23–29 October generated 12 Meta-reported leads versus 6, with spend at NZ$939.71 versus NZ$883.12. Landing-page views fell from 722 to 599, while Meta-reported registrations fell from 5 to 3. The higher lead count has not yet translated into more reported registrations.

findings.title: Static contributed more leads this week
findings.body: During 23–29 October, Video/Reels delivered 7 leads and 3 Meta-reported registrations on NZ$699.29; Static delivered 5 leads and no reported registrations on NZ$240.42. These tracked events are not verified paying customers, so check signup quality before shifting budget.

nextSteps.title: Check the lead-to-registration journey
nextSteps.body: Review the live ad links and mobile sign-up journey, then compare Lead events and Lodg registrations by date and creative. In 23–29 October, more reported leads coincided with fewer reported registrations and fewer landing-page views than the prior week.

nextSteps.title: Review the new ads against registrations
nextSteps.body: Compare each new ad's Meta-reported leads and registrations with Lodg's own records after another full week. Keep the established $47+gst static ad and original Refunding Users creative in the mix while assessing quality; do not scale the repost or IRD Letter static solely on clicks or Lead events.

nextSteps.title: Match reported results to paying customers
nextSteps.body: Reconcile Meta Lead and Complete Registration events against Lodg's registrations and first payouts. Use cost per activated customer, not just cost per Lead, to decide which ads and ad sets deserve more spend.

nextSteps.title: Hold the roughly NZ$4,000 monthly pace for now
nextSteps.body: The last reported allocation was NZ$100/day Video/Reels and NZ$33/day Static (NZ$133/day, roughly NZ$3,990 per 30 days). Confirm the live budgets in Ads Manager before changing them. Reallocate within that total only after checking lead quality and registrations; discuss any increase with Lodg after activation costs are known.
